With a stark visual language and urgent momentum, this is a gripping meditation on survival, power, and the cost of getting what we need.

programme.title: Moon Water
programme.desc: Cloud Gate Dance Theatre's breathtaking tribute to the serene and meditative beauty of water. Inspired by the Buddhist proverb ''Flowers in a mirror and the moon on water are both illusive,'' choreographer Lin Hwai-min has created a poetic exploration of the ever-changing and cyclical nature of life. Set to the backdrop of Bach's Six Cello Suites, played by Mischa Maisky, dancers move in front of a mirror on a reflective stage playing with the elusive nature of reflection. Through years of Tai Chi training with master Shong Wei, the Cloud Gate dancers exude control and balance in their movements giving the impression of sculptural stillness that is nothing short of mesmirizing.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Beethoven: Complete Piano Sonatas: No. 3, Op. 2.3
programme.desc: GRAMMY Award-winning pianist and conductor Daniel Barenboim tackles the so-called "New Testament" of music, Ludwig van Beethoven's thirty-two piano sonatas. Composed over twenty-five years and embodying the shift of musical taste from the Classic to the Romantic, their performance requires a musician of extraordinary versatility. Daniel Barenboim is one such pianist - his recordings run the gamut from Bach and Mozart to Bruckner and Bartók. In following in the footsteps of such masters as Artur Schnabel, Barenboim truly shows himself to be among the greatest living musicians.

programme.title: Don Giovanni Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
programme.desc: Seducer, suborner, unscrupulous, savage, deaf to the lamentations of abandoned women, to the threats of their outraged fathers as to those of heaven, Don Juan the libertine listens only to his pleasures. But destiny is watching, and the vengeance of his victims awaits its time... What does the myth of Don Juan still have to say to us today? For Flemish director Guy Cassiers, the whirlwind of unrelenting love, the dizzying seductions, the swooning ingenues and the lively marivaudages are all fuelled by a hint of violence - physical, symbolic, political and social... But let the party begin! After brilliantly reviving Lully's Xerse and Purcell's Indian Queen in Lille, Guy Cassiers now turns his attention to the immortal seducer, tracking down the conflicts hidden behind his mask of sensual freedom. He has chosen to make her the face of a world in decline, halfway between the crudeness of a slaughterhouse and the splendour of a dazzling palace... Mirror contrasts, as Mozart and Da Ponte's masterpiece combines the most extreme feelings with the most graceful musical refinement... Already a partner of Guy Cassiers in 2015 and 2019, Emmanuelle Haïm returns here to a work in which her passion for Mozart and the singularity of the Concert d'Astrée's timbres work wonders. After the incandescent memories left in Lille by her Marriage of Figaro and a memorable Così fan tutte, here, for the centenary of the Opéra, is this summit of opera.

programme.title: Moon Water
programme.desc: Cloud Gate Dance Theatre's breathtaking tribute to the serene and meditative beauty of water. Inspired by the Buddhist proverb ''Flowers in a mirror and the moon on water are both illusive,'' choreographer Lin Hwai-min has created a poetic exploration of the ever-changing and cyclical nature of life. Set to the backdrop of Bach's Six Cello Suites, played by Mischa Maisky, dancers move in front of a mirror on a reflective stage playing with the elusive nature of reflection. Through years of Tai Chi training with master Shong Wei, the Cloud Gate dancers exude control and balance in their movements giving the impression of sculptural stillness that is nothing short of mesmirizing.

programme.title: Car/Men
programme.desc: Get ready for a daring reimagining of Bizet's timeless classic that turns everything you thought you knew about Carmen upside down. Eight powerhouse male dancers glide, flip, and smolder their way through visionary choreographer Philippe Lafeuille's electrifying spectacle, blending balletic grace with flamenco fire and jaw-dropping acrobatics. Gender norms are playfully shattered; Antonio Macipe's soaring operatic vocals intertwine with the raw energy of street dance, and the iconic "Habanera" is reborn with stunning physicality—crafting a whirlwind of controlled chaos that would leave even Bizet speechless. A bold exploration of desire, power, and identity, this is Carmen redefined—daring, dazzling, and utterly unforgettable.

programme.title: The Sonnets By William Shakespeare
programme.desc: Experience the marvel and mystery of Shakespeare's sonnets like never before in this vivid performance series. This episode features Sonnets 1 to 51, an immortal collection of love poems, brought to life by a star-studded cast including Sir Patrick Stewart, David Tennant, Siân Phillips, and Fiona Shaw. Poets Don Paterson and Sir Andrew Motion lend their voices to some of the most exquisite verses ever written, while leading scholars, such as Professors Katherine Duncan-Jones and James Shapiro, unravel the sonnets' origins and the mindset of their enigmatic author. Each sonnet is performed with highlighted text, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in and understand these timeless works with unparalleled clarity. This groundbreaking series redefines the art of filmed readings.

programme.title: You and Me
programme.desc: Zhang Yimou, the renowned Chinese film director and winner of the Golden Globe Award (Red Cornfield, Red Lantern, Hero, House of Flying Daggers), is staging his first Peking opera at the NCPA, spectacularly fusing the traditional and modern together for his production of You and Me. The result is an overwhelming feast for the senses. Lavish and colorful costumes, unique music composed and conducted by Zhu Shaoyu, and a world class ensemble that features the greatest stars of the Peking opera, including Meng Guanglu, Shi Yihong and Li Mingyan, turn You and Me into an unforgettable experience. You and Me is based on the age-old tale from the Zuo legend "Lord Zheng defeats Duan in Yan" - a story about deceit and the power of filial love. Zhang Yimou recounts the story using the stylistic elements of the Peking opera, which in turn he makes accessible for an entirely new audience.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Beethoven: Complete Piano Sonatas: No. 26, Op. 81a Les adieux
programme.desc: GRAMMY Award-winning pianist and conductor Daniel Barenboim tackles the so-called "New Testament" of music, Ludwig van Beethoven's thirty-two piano sonatas. programme.title: Margot
programme.desc: This is the story of how the most famous dancer that England ever produced was deceived and betrayed by those closest to her; of hos a little girl called Peggy Hookham, brought up in Shanghai, told her mother she would one day become the greatest dancer in the world; and of how, in spite of being almost unable to walk, she was still performing when she was 67.

programme.title: Maestras: A Long Journey of Women to the Podium
programme.desc: When a woman steps onto the conductor's podium, she is always one of "the first": the first to lead a world-class orchestra, the first to conduct the closing night of London's "Proms," the first to win the German Conductor Prize. It seems as though the world of orchestral conducting might finally be ready to change it's attitudes toward female conductors for good.

programme.title: Le nozze di Figaro
programme.desc: "Nothing is harder to put on stage than lightness. And humor is the sharpest weapon of the desperate. That is why it is an obligation, indeed a must, to enjoy this Figaro by Jürgen Flimm at the Staatsoper to the fullest." (ARD Radio) This production of "Le Nozze di Figaro" is directed by Jürgen Flimm, Intendant of the Staatsoper Berlin from 2010 to 2018, who characterizes it as follows: "Figaro is by far the best work ever devised for the stage; it combines everything that moves the human heart and mind - forlorn hope, pleasantry, satire, profound significance, also much ado about nothing and vain amours." This production with a star-studded ensemble of soloists was Flimm's third staging of this musical masterpiece, and this time he places the plot in Count Almaviva's summer residence - a place where the count spent his childhood, a place full of memories where time has left its marks. It is in this hot atmosphere of summer that the great day unfolds: holidays, sun, sea, pretty women take a fancy to pretty men and pretty men take a fancy to pretty women. A midsummer night's dream full of tangled paths and futile longing where the women pull the strings of intrigue with their gentle hands.

programme.title: JA Robot Club
programme.desc: "JA Robot Club" is a playful, high-energy dance film where human movement meets mechanical precision. Created by the innovative JA Collective, this piece pairs six dancers with six small programmable robots, setting the stage for a bold experiment in timing, control, and mechanical and human connection. As the robots glide, spin, and pulse to their own mechanical rhythms, the dancers respond with sharp, responsive, and mesmerizing choreography. The robots don't just accompany the dancers, they lead, challenge, and occasionally surprise them. This is a joyful reminder that even in a tech-driven world, creativity still comes from how we move, adapt, and connect.

programme.title: The Sonnets By William Shakespeare
programme.desc: If only Shakespeare himself could have streamed this episode, which explores the tragedy of absence and yearning. This episode features sonnets 52 to 103. These sonnets rank among his most enthralling works, revealing deep insecurities with unflinching candor. The Bard's poetry comes alive through a stellar cast, including Dame Harriet Walter, Simon Callow, and Stephen Fry, while rare glimpses of the original 1609 quarto transport viewers across four centuries of literary history. Immerse yourself in these masterpieces, where extended metaphors flourish, emotions take shape, and the rhythm of iambic pentameter unveils eternal truths about love, jealousy, and the human condition.

programme.title: Dangerous Liaisons: A Ballet By David Nixon Era CBE
programme.desc: In 18th century France, letters fly between the mansions of two bored aristocrats as they spin a web of heartbreak and ruin. It might seem like a game, but lives will be ruined and love irrevocably lost. From the original scandalous novel, the acclaimed film starring John Malkovich and Michelle Pfeiffer and iconic retelling Cruel Intentions, this dangerous story has been thrilling audiences for over 200 years. Northern Ballet's bodice-ripping adaptation is set to Vivaldi's The Four Seasons, played live by Northern Ballet Sinfonia. You'll feel every heartbeat of this intimate performance.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle - Berliner Philharmoniker - Haydn: The Creation
programme.desc: It was a farewell and the end of an era: Sir Simon Rattle was in Lucerne as principal conductor of the Berliner Philharmoniker one final time this summer. Together, they evoked the original state of the world with a performance of Haydn's Schöpfung. It was a finale that touched upon life through music - thereby proving once again the distinctiveness and the outstanding standard of the artistic cosmos of Rattle and his orchestra. Earlier in the program, they played "ein kleines symphonisches Gedicht" by Georg Friedrich Haas, who was "composer-in-residence" of the Lucerne Festival in 2011. Since 2010, Accentus Music has been in Switzerland together with the Lucerne Festival to document the highlights of Rattle and the Philharmoniker with audiovisual recordings.

programme.title: Tempest
programme.desc: "Tempest," starring Agnes Su of Stuttgart Ballet, is a mesmerizing dance film that captures the delicate tension between aspiration and self-acceptance. With stark simplicity and emotional honesty, Su's performance embodies the beauty and struggle of striving for perfection, revealing the quiet moments where vulnerability and grace meet. Elegant, intimate, and very moving, "Tempest" is a celebration of the artistry in imperfection and the courage it takes to dance on your own terms.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle - Berliner Philharmoniker - Moving to Modern Times
programme.desc: At the Lucerne Festival 2012, Sir Simon Rattle and the Berliner Philharmoniker continued their cycle: "Moving to Modern Times". The evening started off with György Ligeti's "Atmosphères" fading into Richard Wagner's Overture to Lohengrin. Jean Sibelius' 4th Symphony followed and the audience then enjoyed Claude Debussy's "Jeux" and Maurice Ravel's "Daphnis et Chloé". Sir Simon Rattle challenged the audience by stretching the musical arc from Wagner to Ligeti: an exciting programme combination resulting in one of the highlights of this festival.

programme.title: Instinct
programme.desc: Three fighters, one vital resource, no room for compromise. "Instinct" is a tense, physically charged short dance film built around a single life-or-death struggle. As the dancers clash over water, their movement becomes a test of endurance, urgency, and survival. Their movements are sharp, stripped-back, and unflinching. Bodies strain, collide, and resist, mirroring the brutal realities of scarcity and entitlement. Every action carries consequences, and every choice exposes what desperation can bring in each of us. With a stark visual language and urgent momentum, this is a gripping meditation on survival, power, and the cost of getting what we need.

programme.title: Le nozze di Figaro
programme.desc: "Nothing is harder to put on stage than lightness. And humor is the sharpest weapon of the desperate. That is why it is an obligation, indeed a must, to enjoy this Figaro by Jürgen Flimm at the Staatsoper to the fullest." (ARD Radio) This production of "Le Nozze di Figaro" is directed by Jürgen Flimm, Intendant of the Staatsoper Berlin from 2010 to 2018, who characterizes it as follows: "Figaro is by far the best work ever devised for the stage; it combines everything that moves the human heart and mind - forlorn hope, pleasantry, satire, profound significance, also much ado about nothing and vain amours." This production with a star-studded ensemble of soloists was Flimm's third staging of this musical masterpiece, and this time he places the plot in Count Almaviva's summer residence - a place where the count spent his childhood, a place full of memories where time has left its marks. It is in this hot atmosphere of summer that the great day unfolds: holidays, sun, sea, pretty women take a fancy to pretty men and pretty men take a fancy to pretty women. A midsummer night's dream full of tangled paths and futile longing where the women pull the strings of intrigue with their gentle hands.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Beethoven: Complete Piano Sonatas: No. 12, Op. 26
programme.desc: GRAMMY Award-winning pianist and conductor Daniel Barenboim tackles the so-called "New Testament" of music, Ludwig van Beethoven's thirty-two piano sonatas. Composed over twenty-five years and embodying the shift of musical taste from the Classic to the Romantic, their performance requires a musician of extraordinary versatility. Daniel Barenboim is one such pianist - his recordings run the gamut from Bach and Mozart to Bruckner and Bartók. In following in the footsteps of such masters as Artur Schnabel, Barenboim truly shows himself to be among the greatest living musicians.

programme.title: Matthew Bourne's Romeo & Juliet
programme.desc: Passion and heartbreak collide in this contemporary retelling of Shakespeare's timeless tale, exploring the madness of forbidden first love. Locked away in an asylum by a society intent on crushing their youthful spirits, our star-crossed lovers must risk everything to be together. Bourne's trademark storytelling bursts with raw energy, bringing both suppressed and explosive passions to the surface. Romeo and Juliet's first kiss remains unbroken as they roll across the floor and climb stairs, defying the world around them. Cordelia Braithwaite's Juliet is a tragic figure whose strength and courage have been warped by the life forced upon her. The goofy, charming Romeo, played by Paris Fitzpatrick, serves as her perfect foil. The film's shocking climax springs from Juliet's deep trauma. In this radical reinterpretation of Shakespeare's classic, love and sex are portrayed as dangerous forces in a world that demands conformity.

programme.title: Moon Water
programme.desc: Cloud Gate Dance Theatre's breathtaking tribute to the serene and meditative beauty of water. Inspired by the Buddhist proverb ''Flowers in a mirror and the moon on water are both illusive,'' choreographer Lin Hwai-min has created a poetic exploration of the ever-changing and cyclical nature of life. Set to the backdrop of Bach's Six Cello Suites, played by Mischa Maisky, dancers move in front of a mirror on a reflective stage playing with the elusive nature of reflection. Through years of Tai Chi training with master Shong Wei, the Cloud Gate dancers exude control and balance in their movements giving the impression of sculptural stillness that is nothing short of mesmirizing.

programme.title: Instinct
programme.desc: Three fighters, one vital resource, no room for compromise. "Instinct" is a tense, physically charged short dance film built around a single life-or-death struggle. As the dancers clash over water, their movement becomes a test of endurance, urgency, and survival. Their movements are sharp, stripped-back, and unflinching. programme.title: Haydn's Creation from Ljubljana Festival
programme.desc: A cosmic drama of light, life, and music, Haydn's "The Creation" is reborn in this dazzling new staging. Joseph Haydn's monumental oratorio "The Creation" is one of the great masterpieces of the Classical Era. Written in 1798 and inspired by Handel's great oratorios, "The Creation" tells the biblical story of the world's creation with breathtaking drama, poetry, and spiritual depth. From the primordial chaos before creation to the jubilant dawn of life, Haydn's score remains as powerful and moving today as it was at its premiere in 1799. At the 73rd Ljubljana Festival in Slovenia, Haydn's monumental work takes on a captivating new life in a visionary staging by La Fura dels Baus, the ground-breaking Catalan theatre collective celebrated for their bold fusion of classical music with incredible stage design. This production transforms Haydn's score into an immersive experience where music, theater, and visual storytelling come together to create an unforgettable experience. The incredible ADDA Simfònica Alicante and the Slovenian Philharmonic Choir, led by Josep Vincent, give an outstanding performance. Soloists Alba Fernández-Cano, Víctor Sordo, and Toni Marsol bring the archangels and first humans to life, infusing Haydn's beloved music with dramatic power. This is "The Creation" as you've never seen it before.

programme.title: Move to Live with Akram Khan
programme.desc: Olivier Award-winning Actress and Director Kathryn Hunter is renowned for her work with physical theatre, notably with the pioneering theatre company Complicité, co-founded by her late husband Marcello Magni. She talks to Akram about her work with Marcello and how movement has always been a cornerstone of her approach to acting. Shakespeare has also been a cornerstone of Kathryn's career and she discusses her approach to playing the "Everest" of roles, King Lear, in two different productions spanning a 25-year timeframe. She also talks about how different stages make her move differently and recalls how screenwriter Joel Cohen wanted her to combine the physicality of a crow combined with a standing stone for his film The Tragedy of Macbeth. And Kathryn tells Akram how a serious accident left her with life-changing injuries but how this resulted in her thinking anew about how she could communicate physically.

programme.title: Herbie Hancock Meets Bobby McFerrin and Michael Brecker
programme.desc: In this 1988 performance, The Herbie Hancock Trio plays together with famed vocalist Bobby McFerrin and saxophonist Michael Brecker. Jazz pianist and composer Herbie Hancock is perhaps one of the most famous contributors to the post-bop (a small combo jazz style) sound of the 1960s and '70s. He began his career with the Miles Davis Quintet where he helped to revolutionize the jazz rhythm section and later became known for his early adoption of the synthesizer, which led to his signature Jazz Rock Fusion style. In this live 1988 concert, held at the Munich Philharmonie, The Herbie Hancock Trio, with Hancock on piano, Buster Williams on bass, and Al Foster on drums, welcome vocalist Bobby McFerrin and saxophonist Michael Brecker for a mostly improvised concert. Together they play some of Hancock's most famous compositions, and in the second half, Hancock improvises on an IBM computer-enhanced Bösendorf Concert Grand. Set List: Air Dancing Oleo Improvisation 2 Hands Improvisation 4 Hands Cantaloupe Island 2 Hands Cantaloupe Island 4 Hands.

programme.title: The Herbie Hancock Trio
programme.desc: Watch Herbie Hancock and his Trio perform at the 1987 Munich Summer Piano Festival. Today, Herbie Hancock is fostering the next generation of great jazz musicians as the chairman of UCLA's Herbie Hancock Institute of Jazz. In 1987, he was influencing jazz in a different way. In that year, he won the Oscar for Best Musical Score and set off on a string of European concerts with his world-famous trio. This 1987 concert from Munich's Summer Piano Festival is the epitome of cool. Herbie Hancock opens with a casual and hypnotic piano solo and is then joined by Buster Williams on bass, and Al Foster on drums. Together they play songs from Herbie's 1966 album Maiden Voyage, one of Buster Williams' original compositions, and round things off with a classic Cole Porter tune. Set List: Dolphin Dance Air Dancing Just One of Those Things.

programme.title: Don Giovanni Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
programme.desc: Seducer, suborner, unscrupulous, savage, deaf to the lamentations of abandoned women, to the threats of their outraged fathers as to those of heaven, Don Juan the libertine listens only to his pleasures. But destiny is watching, and the vengeance of his victims awaits its time... What does the myth of Don Juan still have to say to us today? For Flemish director Guy Cassiers, the whirlwind of unrelenting love, the dizzying seductions, the swooning ingenues and the lively marivaudages are all fuelled by a hint of violence - physical, symbolic, political and social... But let the party begin! After brilliantly reviving Lully's Xerse and Purcell's Indian Queen in Lille, Guy Cassiers now turns his attention to the immortal seducer, tracking down the conflicts hidden behind his mask of sensual freedom. He has chosen to make her the face of a world in decline, halfway between the crudeness of a slaughterhouse and the splendour of a dazzling palace... Mirror contrasts, as Mozart and Da Ponte's masterpiece combines the most extreme feelings with the most graceful musical refinement... Already a partner of Guy Cassiers in 2015 and 2019, Emmanuelle Haïm returns here to a work in which her passion for Mozart and the singularity of the Concert d'Astrée's timbres work wonders. After the incandescent memories left in Lille by her Marriage of Figaro and a memorable Così fan tutte, here, for the centenary of the Opéra, is this summit of opera.

programme.title: Car/Men
programme.desc: Get ready for a daring reimagining of Bizet's timeless classic that turns everything you thought you knew about Carmen upside down. Eight powerhouse male dancers glide, flip, and smolder their way through visionary choreographer Philippe Lafeuille's electrifying spectacle, blending balletic grace with flamenco fire and jaw-dropping acrobatics. Gender norms are playfully shattered; Antonio Macipe's soaring operatic vocals intertwine with the raw energy of street dance, and the iconic "Habanera" is reborn with stunning physicality—crafting a whirlwind of controlled chaos that would leave even Bizet speechless. A bold exploration of desire, power, and identity, this is Carmen redefined—daring, dazzling, and utterly unforgettable.

programme.title: The Sonnets By William Shakespeare
programme.desc: If only Shakespeare himself could have streamed this episode, which explores the tragedy of absence and yearning. This episode features sonnets 52 to 103. These sonnets rank among his most enthralling works, revealing deep insecurities with unflinching candor. The Bard's poetry comes alive through a stellar cast, including Dame Harriet Walter, Simon Callow, and Stephen Fry, while rare glimpses of the original 1609 quarto transport viewers across four centuries of literary history. Immerse yourself in these masterpieces, where extended metaphors flourish, emotions take shape, and the rhythm of iambic pentameter unveils eternal truths about love, jealousy, and the human condition.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Beethoven: Complete Piano Sonatas: No. 29, Op. 106 Hammerklavier
programme.desc: GRAMMY Award-winning pianist and conductor Daniel Barenboim tackles the so-called "New Testament" of music, Ludwig van Beethoven's thirty-two piano sonatas. Composed over twenty-five years and embodying the shift of musical taste from the Classic to the Romantic, their performance requires a musician of extraordinary versatility. Daniel Barenboim is one such pianist - his recordings run the gamut from Bach and Mozart to Bruckner and Bartók. programme.title: Viva Verdi
programme.desc: Celebrating Verdi's bi-centenary, the spectacular National Centre for the Performing Arts in Beijing hosted a unique Gala Concert, produced by Accentus Music: An international cast of renowned European and Chinese singers and the NCPA orchestra under the baton of its principal conductor Lu Jia presented a wide selection of Verdi opera classics. "Viva Verdi" was directed and staged by the multi talented Verdi specialist Hugo de Ana, acclaimed for exquisite scenery sets as well as for his extraordinary lighting design.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Dve sestre. Dve eksplozivne ličnosti. Pod jednim krovom. "Sestre" je komedija o svakodnevnom životu dve sestre, od kojih jedna ima 7, a druga 13 godina. Marin je i dalje dete, dok njena starija sestra Vendi ulazi u tinejdžerske godine. Obe su temperamentne, veoma različite ličnosti i obožavaju se! Marin je naivna, simpatična, veoma hiperaktivna i veoma napadna. Ona uvek smišlja lude ideje da bi privukla pažnju svoje sestre, dok Vendi više teži životu odrasle osobe. Ova komedija karaktera govori o bratstvu/sestrinstvu.

programme.title: Džeronimo Stilton
programme.desc: Džeronimo je gospodin miš koji, pored toga što voli svoj posao i svoju porodicu, obožava da skuplja korice starog sira iz osamnaestog veka. Mrzi da putuje jer mu svako putovanje, bilo brodom, kolima ili avionom, izaziva mučninu... Ali ga, bez obzira na to, porodica uvlači u najneverovatnije pustolovine svuda po svetu.

programme.title: Zoro
programme.desc: Naša nova serija predstavlja tinejdžera Don Dijega, koji se suočava sa najvećim životnim izazovom boreći se za pravdu protiv brojnih bezobzirnih tirana! Tako se rađa najpoznatiji maskirani heroj. Zoro jednostavno ismeva svoje protivnike učeći ih lekciji i potpisuje svoja dela zaštitnim znakom "Z".

programme.title: Otvorena sezona - Zov prirode
programme.desc: Bug i Eliot se zbližavaju sa Dinom i njegovom bandom oposuma, uzbudljivim, ali sumnjivim likovima. Privučeni sjajem televizije, video igara i ukusne nezdrave hrane, ne primećuju šta se zaista dešava.

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Solti, jedan od mačora Kraljevske garde, paralisan je od strane zagonetnog viteza sa natprirodnim moćima.

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Fleš, prvak u trkama hrtova, nestaje iz svog ultrabezbednog kaveza pod nerazjašnjenim okolnostima noć pre važne trke.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Pošto mora da pronađe neki posao da bi mogao da kupi najnoviju video igricu, Alvin odlučuje da ''pozajmi'' Britanin posao i čuva decu. Ali Bazil nije oduševljen što Alvin mora da ga čuva. Zato je spremio haos za Alvina.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Tokom posete zoološkom vrtu u kostimima, za Alvina će pomisliti da je pravi Tasmanijski džavo. Ova yabuna će napraviti mnogo problema, pogotovo kad Sajmon pročita da Tasmanijski đavo mora na operaciju. Da li će Dejv i momci spasiti Alvina.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Jedne olujne noći, Pets klub se suočava sa zastrašujućim zadatkom: da nađu Baa, kraljevskog pitona Viktorovog oca, koji se krije negde u toj sumornoj kući. Mada Nina, Tim i Marlu mogu da ostanu pribrani, Oskar ne može, previše se plaši zmija! Dok klub vodi istragu u prizemlju, tragajući za pitonom na najmudrije i najneobičnije načine, Oskar odlazi na sprat, gde će možda naići na još strašnije stvorenje..

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Matilda ne može da nađe Sultana, svoje sijamsko mače. Nakon istraživanja, Pets klub ga pronalazi na vrhu drveta u parku. Uspeva da ga spasi. Ali Sultanovo ponašanje potpuno se promenilo: više neće da se igra i sad kaki svuda. Matilda više ne prepoznaje svoje voljeno mače. Šta se dešava? Nakon razgovora sa staricom koja je Matildi poklonila mače, Pets klub saznaje da se Sultan nije odvajao od svog brata.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad na posao
programme.desc: Uz pomoć svog starijeg brata i partnera, Tima, Mali šef nastavlja da se bori u surovom korporativnom svetu firme Bebeći Odred, dok se svim silama trudi da postigne skoro neverovatnu stvar: balans između poslovnog i privatnog života.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad na posao
programme.desc: Uz pomoć svog starijeg brata i partnera, Tima, Mali šef nastavlja da se bori u surovom korporativnom svetu firme Bebeći Odred, dok se svim silama trudi da postigne skoro neverovatnu stvar: balans između poslovnog i privatnog života.

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Fleš, prvak u trkama hrtova, nestaje iz svog ultrabezbednog kaveza pod nerazjašnjenim okolnostima noć pre važne trke.

programme.title: Anderdog - Kuconja
programme.desc: Nakon još jednog kvara, Robo-kuca napušta branioce. Ali ovaj kvar je izazvao Simke Zloća, koji je ubacio virus u Štab Branilaca i Robo-kucu da bi ubacio svoj program SimkeSink u glavni računar! Ali Krle opet pravi grešku i Simke ga otpušta! Zameniće ga... Robo-kucom, koja je malo izgubljena. Za to vreme, Branioci moraju da se bore protiv... hakovanog glavnog računara. Zarobljeni su u Štabu Branilaca.

programme.title: Anderdog - Kuconja
programme.desc: Veliki Pas je zvezda Dana zagrljaja, koji je organizovala gradonačelnica. Mačkoslav koristi robote za grljenje koji izgledaju kao Veliki Pas da bi opljačkao sve! Da bi se rešili branilaca, roboti se pretvaraju u džinovskog robotskog crva.

programme.title: Nekada Davno - Predmeti
programme.desc: Maestro je povredio prst dok je ljuštio povrće. Njegova potraga za zavojem odvodi ga u drevni Egipat gde se rane leče mesom, medom ili previjaju zavojem! Maestro je skeptičan dok ide da se susretne sa Hipokratom, a zatim i sa doktorom iz doba Napoleona u potrazi za boljim zavojem.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Svake godine, Vendi je zadužena za rođendansku zabavu svoje mlađe sestre. To je njena prilika da zasija pred Marinom i njenim drugarima koji je obožavaju i misle da je najbolja domaćica. Ali ove godine njihov tata želi da bude najbolji u kući! On se krišom prerušava u Super Piju-Pijua da bi iznenadio Marinu. Vendi nije presrećna što joj to debelo pile krade slavu. A kad on počne da se šunja po kući u potrazi za Marininim rođendanskim poklonima, devojke će pomisliti da je provalnik. Sezona lova na Piju-Pijua počinje.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Nećak gospođe Žoržete, Ašil, provodi popodne sa sestrama. Marina i Vendi se takmiče u tome koja će biti finija prema njemu. Da bi mu privukle pažnju, obe namerno uništavaju pokušaje one druge. Za Ašila to možda i nije tako lep dan..

programme.title: Barbi rok zvezda
programme.desc: Spremite se za rok! U ovom optimističnom mjuziklu, Barbi glumi Kortni, modernu princezu čiji se svet okrenuo naglavačke kada je zamenila mesta sa Erikom, poznatom rok zvezdom. Dva veoma različita sveta se sudaraju kada je zbog zabune princeza Kortni poslata u Pop kamp,a Erika, u Kraljevski kamp. Dok vođe rivalskih kampova pokušavaju da isprave zabunu, i Kortni i Erika uče kako da se prilagode drugačijim svetovima i zabavljaju se prilikom sticanja novih, neočekivanih prijatelja. Kada devojke shvate da su oba kampa u opasnosti od zatvaranja, one moraju da prihvate svoje razlike, pronađu svoje pravo ja, i da dođu zajedno na neverovatano nadpevavanje koje pokazuje šta je sve moguće kada se usudiš da sanjaš velike snove.

programme.title: Barbi - Dodir Čarolije
programme.desc: Barbi i Barbi nalaze misteriozno ždrebe na plaži u Malibuu i ubrzo shvataju da je mali konj zapravo beba Pegaz! Zajedničkim snagama se trude da vrate malu Pegi kući štiteći je od Rokija, fantastičnog Glifa. Na već poznatoj lokaciji u Malibuu Barbi, Barbi i njihovi prijatelji shvataju da se magija zaista može naći svuda oko nas.

programme.title: Lego prijatelji: Sledeće poglavlje
programme.desc: Alija, Otem, Lijen i Nova organizuju prespavanjac u Oteminoj štali. Leo i Zak su oduševljeni Novinim dronom, te će i oni doći na prespavanjac kako bi saznali više o njemu. Strašna priča, nestanak hrane, munje, gromovi, jezivi zvukovi i sablasne senke navode družinu da posumnjaju na duhove.

programme.title: Nekada Davno - Predmeti
programme.desc: Maestra i Psi iznenađuje oluja. Nažalost, nemaju kišobran. Maestro vodi Psi u potragu za jednim. Otkrivaju da se prvi kišobran pojavio u Kini pre više od 3.000 godina. Nije prilagođen kiši i koristi se kao zaštita od sunca.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Sutra je Marinin rođendan, pa ona dosađuje Vendi tražeći da joj kaže kakav poklon će dobiti. Vendi odbija da joj kaže, ali Marina to ipak saznaje: dobiće vodootpornu Vilu Dronicu... I Marina otvara poklon. Možemo samo da zamislimo haos koji će dron napraviti po celoj kući, pa čak i po komšiluku, kad ga se sestre dočepaju.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Tata je ponudio Rašel (Vendinoj najgoroj neprijateljici) da ostane kod njih tokom vikenda... To je noćna mora! Vendi ne može da računa ni na Marininu pomoć, jer izgleda da je i ona potpala pod Vendine čini. Naravno, Rašel je čista manipulatorka. Marina i Vendi uskoro će biti zamalo izbačene iz sopstvene kuće! Hoće li uspeti da povrate svoju teritoriju pre nego što se roditelji vrate.

programme.title: Alvin i veverice
programme.desc: Bokarter se hvali svojim računarom, a dečaci osećaju pritisak da budu u korak sa neprijateljem i izazovu katastrofu.

programme.title: Alvin i veverice
programme.desc: Kad novi dečački bend Neverice pokuša da ukrade pažnju, Veverice su primorane da se takmiče u bici bendova.

programme.title: Alvin i veverice
programme.desc: Direktorka daje Alvinu i Dereku ultimatum - ako se budu svađali, školski ples će biti otkazan.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Kada se crvena veverica odjednom nađe u afričkoj savani, ekipa aktivira moći geparda da bi je uhvatila. Nažalost, nailazi na velike probleme sa moćnim odelima. Modulator repova je pokvaren i daje pogrešan rep sa svakom aktivacijom. Tokom pokušaja da vrati vevericu kući u Severnu Ameriku, ekipa otkriva zadivljujuću raznolikost i mnoge funkcije životinjskih repova.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: U afričkoj savani Kris i Martin posmatraju mnogo divljih pasa i mačaka koji se susreću. Klinci iz ekipe Kret širom sveta zovu da se raspitaju o psima i mačkama i tome koliko oni liče na njihove ljubimce. Zak krišom prisluškuje sva pitanja i smišlja plan kako da zarobi i proda ova stvorenja kao ""posebne"" ljubimce. Braća Aviva, Koki i Džimi žure da spasu divlje mačke i pse i zaštite njihov slobodan život u divljini.

programme.title: Nekada Davno - Predmeti
programme.desc: Maestro mora da obnovi svoju karticu za muzej, ali je zaboravio da se fotografiše. Kreće u potragu za fotografom. Počinje u 11. veku u Egiptu, gde mu lice biva projektovano naopako unutar kamere opskure koja pripada učenjaku po imenu Alhazen. Osam vekova kasnije, Maestro se susreće sa pravim pionirima moderne fotografije.

programme.title: Nekada Davno - Predmeti
programme.desc: Maestro govori maloj Psi da njene farmerke nisu običan par pantalona. Sve je počelo u Italiji, u Đenovi, gde je "džins" bio naziv za tkaninu koja je putovala preko mora da bi na kraju stigla do Sjedinjenih Američkih Država gde su je koristili da prave odeću 1873. Kako sreću hipike, motocikliste i filmske zvezde, Maestro pokazuje kako je džins postao simbol slobode.

programme.title: Radoznali Džordž
programme.desc: Džordž obožava ćufte-ponedeljak kod Šefa Pizgetija, naročito kad ih on i Majk ručaju na svojoj terasi. Kod kuće otkrivaju da je Džordž zaboravio da zaključa ulazna vrata, i on obećava da se to neće ponoviti. Dok postavljaju sto na terasi, Džordž se seti da je ostavio ćufte u predvorju. Trči po njih i, kao dobar mali majmun, zaključava vrata za sobom. Kad se vrati, Džordž shvata da ne može da uđe u zaključan stan - i da je zaključao svog druga na terasi! / Džordž obožava da istražuje šumu. Jednog dana, skupljajući kamenje, štapove i šišarke, Džordž nalazi novo čudo - pljosnatu crvenu bubu! Džordža zanima i sva ta kora na zemlji, a Bil mu objašnjava da kora štiti drvo kao oklop - koji drvo odbacuje kad ga preraste.

programme.title: Radoznali Džordž
programme.desc: Džordž voli da ga vuku u kolicima tokom sunčanog jutra. Naročito danas, kada sreće Viki i Vinija koji prodaju keksiće! Kako da odluči koji ukusni keksić da kupi - sa bananom i lešnicima, ili sa ovsenim pahuljicama? Po jedan od oba, naravno! Džordž želi da pomogne drugarima i nudi se da obavi najvažniji posao - da dostavi već prodate kutije. / Džordž voli da posmatra prirodu, naročito životinje. A danas je poseban dan. Džordž posećuje azil za slonove u Keniji, gde je Majk radio nekad davno, sa svojim najstarijim drugaricama - upravnicom Ciku i slonicom po imenu Išanga.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Pinto konj Uragan nestaje jedne olujne noći. Njegova vlasnica Žad nada se da će mladi istraživači naći njenog konja pre konjičkog ispita koji se bliži. Naši heroji pretražuju okolinu i sumnjaju na komšiju koji je jahač amater, ali ne mogu da nađu begunca! Na kraju će otkriti da je sama Žad sakrila svog konja! U stvari, iskoristila je oluju da bi inscenirala njegovo bekstvo.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Nina je vrlo uzbuđena jer je slavna glumica iz televizijske serije Sonja pozvala Pets klub zbog Čarapice, njene male mačke, koja nakon nesreće ima samo tri noge. Uprkos tome i uprkos strahu od automobila, Čarapica je uspela da pobegne iz dvorišta. Dok Nina sanja da će joj Sonja pomoći da postane glumica, dešavaju se čudne stvari: Marlu se krije u garaži, pas vuče svoju vlasnicu, a Čarapica, kada je najzad pronađu, ostaje prestravljena! Šta se to dešava u kraju.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Tokom šetnje hrastovom šumom, Pets klub otkriva izgubljenu patuljastu svinju. Deca je vode u jazbinu i postavljaju oglas da bi našla njenog vlasnika. Ubrzo saznaju da je Tvrdoglavko svinja koja traži tartufe, retke i skupe pečurke, po hrastovim šumama u kojima rastu. Srećom, zahvaljujući oglasu, njen vlasnik dolazi i utovara ga u svoj kombi. Ali njegovo čudno ponašanje, činjenica da nije znao svinjino ime i da nije oklevao da ga maltretira, uzbunjuju Pets klub.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Danas je dan za predaju naučnih radova! Iako su Nina i Oskar spremni, Tim se sa druge strane baš muči sa svojom plazma kuglom koja više ne radi! Mora da je popravi na pauzi za ručak. Ali pred njima je važniji zadatak: beli miš kog je Kamel koristio za prezentaciju je pobegao! Naši heroji tragaju za malim glodarom, sakrivenim negde u školi! Moraće da prevaziđu mnoge opasnosti i prepreke: izgladnelog Oskara, preteću zbornicu, šašavog naučnika specijalizovanog za eksperimente na miševima.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Vrućina pod Arbaklovim krovom je nepodnošljiva. U stvari, svuda je nepodnošljiva. Jedina osoba koja izgleda srećno zbog toplotnog talasa je prodavac, čija je prodaja klima-uređaja, sladoleda i kreme za sunčanje naglo skočila. Nažalost po Džona, ovo je dan kada je obećao bliznakinjama Drusili i Minervi da će ih odvesti u šumu na kampovanje. Odi i veoma nezadovoljni Garfild su odvučeni sa njima. Ono što je delovalo kao užasno vrelo kampovanje na kraju ispada veoma prijatno, jer počinje da pada kiša. Ali počinje da pada sneg.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Neka pada grad! Neka padaju sendviči! Nešto veoma čudno se dešava i izgleda da to čudno vreme potiče od jednog oblaka. Dok se oblak kreće, svi ga prate i istražuju. Kad ga usisa dimnjak kuće, oni dolaze do strašnog otkrića da su u to umešani prodavac i izvesni čovek po imenu Visoki Pritisak.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Aviva i Kris prave spisak svih diskova sa moćima životinja na palubi Tortuge kad Martin ugleda ajkulu čekićaru. U trenutku uzbuđenja, obara sve diskove u okean. Braća ubrzo shvataju da postoji samo jedan način da ih vrate: pomoću moći čekićare.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Ekipa Kret se razdvaja širom Amazonije u potrazi za čudnom grupom mini-majmuna, u želji da sazna zašto imaju tako upadljive frizure i boje.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Kad Aviva ostane bez ideja za nove izume, ekipa Kret je odlučna u nameri da joj pomogne. Vodi je niz tajanstvenu reku Amazon u potrazi za nadahnućem među zadivljujućim stvorenjima koja tamo žive. Ali Aviva mora brzo da povrati svoje pronalazačke sposobnosti, jer Zak, Donita, Gurman i Pejzli žele da raznesu sve oblasti pune raznolikog života, zbog svojih zlokobnih planova. Bez Avivinih zadivljujućih pronalazačkih moći, Amazon je možda zauvek izgubljen.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad u kolevku
programme.desc: Nagon događaja u filmu Mali Šef 2, odraslom poslovnom čoveku Teodoru Templtonu smeštena je pronevera u kompaniji i primoran je da se vrati svom starom ja, Malom Šefu, i živi sa svojim bratom Timom. Ali da bi to izveo, mora da navede Timovu porodicu da mu dopusti da ostane, i ubedi Bebiko da mu vrati njegov stari posao... Koji trenutno obavlja njegova nećaka, beba Tina.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad u kolevku
programme.desc: Nagon događaja u filmu Mali Šef 2, odraslom poslovnom čoveku Teodoru Templtonu smeštena je pronevera u kompaniji i primoran je da se vrati svom starom ja, Malom Šefu, i živi sa svojim bratom Timom. Ali da bi to izveo, mora da navede Timovu porodicu da mu dopusti da ostane, i ubedi Bebiko da mu vrati njegov stari posao... Koji trenutno obavlja njegova nećaka, beba Tina.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Mjau-mjau! Pogledaj to siroto neodoljivo mače! Sad pažljivo! Taj slatki anđeo u stvari je đavo! Džon i Odi su potpuno prevareni kada ga ugledaju na ulici i odluče da ga vode kući, ali Anđelak ubrzo pravi potpuni džumbus po kući. Jede Džonovu tortu koju Liz namerava da proda, cepa zavese... Za to će okriviti Garfilda i svi će stati na stranu te užasne mačke: Odi juri Garfilda po kući, a Džon ga čak tera napolje! Ali taj Anđelak je sladokusac, a Garfild ima plan: šta ako pomogne šinteru Alu da uhvati nevaljalog Anđelka.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Mjau-mjau! Pogledaj to siroto neodoljivo mače! Sad pažljivo! Taj slatki anđeo u stvari je đavo! Džon i Odi su potpuno prevareni kada ga ugledaju na ulici i odluče da ga vode kući, ali Anđelak ubrzo pravi potpuni džumbus po kući. Jede Džonovu tortu koju Liz namerava da proda, cepa zavese... Za to će okriviti Garfilda i svi će stati na stranu te užasne mačke: Odi juri Garfilda po kući, a Džon ga čak tera napolje! Ali taj Anđelak je sladokusac, a Garfild ima plan: šta ako pomogne šinteru Alu da uhvati nevaljalog Anđelka.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina pogrešno veruje da roditelji više vole Vendi i odlučuje da to promeni! Ali kad pokuša da ugodi roditeljima, upada u još veću nevolju. Srećom, Vendi je tu da spreči svaku katastrofu. Ali Vendi ne može da pazi na Marinu u svakom trenutku i Marina na kraju završava kažnjena. Da bi se osvetila, mala napast uvaljuje i Vendi u nevolju i obe bivaju zatvorene u svojim sobama! Izjednačeno jes! Sad samo treba da nađu način da se izvuku iz kazne..

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Postoji Dan majki i Dan očeva, ali šta je sa sestrama? Marina objavljuje da je danas Dan sestara i sprema poklon za Vendi. Ali njena sestra samo želi da je ostave na miru! Ako je tako, Marina će joj dati prostora... I pobrinuće se za to da Vendi stvarno bude sama ceo dan! Grr... Da bi joj se osvetila, Vendi odlučuje da pobedi Marinu njenim oružjem.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina želi da natera Vendi i Maksansa da prođu kroz pet ključnih faza za parove, o kojima je čitala u časopisu o popularnoj psihologiji, ali ubrzano. Posle jedne baš užasne svađe, otkrivanja intimne tajne, zajedničkog života i rođenja bebe, Vendi i Maksans moraju da postanu stari par, baš kao mama i tata! Onda neće zuriti jedno u drugo po ceo dan i Vendi će konačno moći da provede vreme sa svojom sestrom.

programme.title: Hotel za ljubimce
programme.desc: Jednog dana, NeiNei pretura po gomili smeća u potrazi za doručkom. Vozač motocikla slučajno ispušta vreću sa hranom za mačke. NeiNei je tako uzbuđen što će napokon nešto pojesti da proždire sve iz vreće. Pošto se toliko prejeo da ne može ni da ustane, NeiNei pada u nesvest. Robin prolazi i nalazi NeiNeija. Vodi ga u hotel za ljubimce, gde NeiNei upoznaje Bubua, Lilija i Viki.

programme.title: Hotel za ljubimce
programme.desc: Osorni čovek ulazi i spušta nosiljku za ljubimce na pult. Govori Robinu da je to prvi put da je njegov ljubimac van doma i da ne želi da dozvoli da se igra sa uličnim životinjama. NeiNei čuje razgovor i ljuti se. Pozdravlja se i napušta hotel. Bubu, Lili i Viki saznaju ko je ljubimac u nosiljci - to je zmija! DIRECTOR.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Jedne olujne noći, Pets klub se suočava sa zastrašujućim zadatkom: da nađu Baa, kraljevskog pitona Viktorovog oca, koji se krije negde u toj sumornoj kući. Mada Nina, Tim i Marlu mogu da ostanu pribrani, Oskar ne može, previše se plaši zmija! Dok klub vodi istragu u prizemlju, tragajući za pitonom na najmudrije i najneobičnije načine, Oskar odlazi na sprat, gde će možda naići na još strašnije stvorenje..

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Matilda ne može da nađe Sultana, svoje sijamsko mače. Nakon istraživanja, Pets klub ga pronalazi na vrhu drveta u parku. Uspeva da ga spasi. Ali Sultanovo ponašanje potpuno se promenilo: više neće da se igra i sad kaki svuda. Matilda više ne prepoznaje svoje voljeno mače. Šta se dešava? Nakon razgovora sa staricom koja je Matildi poklonila mače, Pets klub saznaje da se Sultan nije odvajao od svog brata.

programme.title: Anderdog - Kuconja
programme.desc: Mačkoslav otkriva da nije čak ni među sto najvećih pretnji u gradu. Koristi odelo koje mu omogućava da prolazi kroz zidove da maltretira građane. Sa druge strane, Kuconja ne oseća da ga drugari dovoljno slušaju. Oseća se zanemareno.

programme.title: Anderdog - Kuconja
programme.desc: Poli je krišom napravila svog klona da bi se zabavila. Nažalost, Lošika saznaje to i otima pravu Poli! Kada branioci saznaju da imaju posla sa klonom, biće potpuno izgubljeni.

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Prema rečima goluba Alfreda, stari aviarijum u Bakingamskoj palati je začaran: živi gargojl plaši sve ptice koje se približe. Ali Klever misli da, iako je Alfred možda sanjar, tragovi ne lažu.

programme.title: Alvin i veverice
programme.desc: Da bi dobio glavnu ulogu u predstavi, Alvin se kladi sa Britani da može da bude predan ulozi obućara.

programme.title: Alvin i veverice
programme.desc: Britani je ubeđena da je davno izgubljena princeza i preteruje sa svojim novim kraljevskim statusom.

programme.title: Alvin i veverice
programme.desc: Trener Dobkins izbacuje Sirišu i Teodora iz tima zato što su spori, ali Teodor je rešen da se takmiči.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Kako biste voleli da provedete vikend na farmi sa Džonovim bratom? Bez pice i televizije? Za Garfilda ne postoji ništa gore od toga. Ali moraće da prati svog vlasnika i, što je još gore, moraće da radi! Da, tako je! Naš drugar Garfild će morati da plasti seno, cepa drva, hrani svinje, piliće i konja, daje kravama vodu, radi u polju, čak i da sadi kukuruz! Mislite da je to nemoguće? Zahvaljujući doktoru Viplu, velikom hipnotizeru, sve je moguće. Ali isto važi i za Garfilda. Možda će na kraju i hipnotizer završiti hipnotisan.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: U poslednje vreme, obično razdragani Edi je loše raspoložen. Svima daje loše kritike, čak i Vitovoj piceriji. Ali on ne blati samo restorane: izgleda da niko nije bezbedan od žaoke Edija Gurmana, čak ni ulice! Edi je toliko protiv svega da mu šef naređuje da ide kod lekara. Kada Džon, Odi i Garfild odluče da obiđu Edija, na kraju će sa njim otići kod lekara, koji želi da isproba novi izum koji će ući u Edijev mozak. Garfild ne može to da propusti i, naravno, prosto mora da zaviri u mozak Edija Gurmana.

programme.title: Kruds - Porodično Stablo
programme.desc: Dok je roditelji obučavaju, Ip se takmiči u Alfaborbi - turniru u kom se svi iz životinjskog carstva takmiče da bi odredili koja je vrsta dominantna. Ali kada Ip sazna da bi pobeda čoveka mogla da naruši prirodnu ravnotežu, mora da izabere između pobede kojom bi učinila roditelje posnosnim, i poraza kojim bi zaštitila druge životinje.

programme.title: Kruds - Porodično Stablo
programme.desc: Fil i Gaj pokušavaju da ospore verovanje Krudsa da ostavljanje poklona plamenom mesecu sprečava lošu sreću. Ali kad njihovi pokušaji izazovu niz nezgoda, moraće da uzmu rog opasne ovanakonde da bi preokrenuli svoju sreću.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Kad saznaju da njihovi roditelji idu na koncert Džoj-Dija bez njih, devojke shvataju da nisu baš mnogo pomagale u kućnim poslovima. Nadajući se nagradi, odlučuju da očiste kuću od poda do plafona! Ali postaju opsednute čišćenjem i pretvaraju se u šašave čistunice.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: "Ovo je nezgodan zadatak za sestre: moraju ponovo da spoje roditelje, za koje veruju da su ljuti zbog nereda koji su one napravile. Odlučuju da prirede romantičnu večeru koja se uskoro pretvara u takmičenje u tome ko će smisliti bolje ""romantično iznenađenje"".

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Dve sestre. Dve eksplozivne ličnosti. Pod jednim krovom. Sestre je komedija o svakodnevnom životu dve sestre, od kojih jedna ima 7, a druga 13 godina. Marin je i dalje dete, dok njena starija sestra Vendi ulazi u tinejdžerske godine. Obe su temperamentne, veoma različite ličnosti i obožavaju se! Marin je naivna, simpatična, veoma hiperaktivna i veoma napadna. Ona uvek smišlja lude ideje da bi privukla pažnju svoje sestre, dok Vendi više teži životu odrasle osobe. Ova komedija karaktera govori o bratstvu/sestrinstvu.

programme.desc: Dobrodošli u carstvo tatinih ćerki u kom žive polusestre Panda, Ondin, Roksana i beba Bela. Zavirite u nepredvidivu i razdraganu svakodnevnicu ove nekonvencionalne porodice. Ovaj porodični sitkom prosto morate da pogledate.

programme.title: Živeti S Tatom
programme.desc: Dobrodošli u carstvo tatinih ćerki u kom žive polusestre Panda, Ondin, Roksana i beba Bela. Zavirite u nepredvidivu i razdraganu svakodnevnicu ove nekonvencionalne porodice. Ovaj porodični sitkom prosto morate da pogledate.

programme.title: Nekada davno... Planeta Zemlja
programme.desc: Putujemo širom Indije uz pomoć vodiča, člana kluba "Čuvari planete", i otkrivamo probleme povezane sa zagađenjem i nestašicom vode.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Kad optuže Alvina da svima kvari omiljenu seriju, on pristane da ne priča 24 sati.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Kad Alvin i Sajmon pomisle da je Teodorova ribica uginula, pokušaju da je zamene pre nego što on to primeti.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Alvin i Britani otkriju da roditeljstvo nije lako kad im je zadatak da se staraju o robotskoj bebi.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Kad Alvinom fudbalskm timu krene loše, trener ih natera da nauče balet i vrate se u formu.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Alvin misli da je poludeo kad Sajmon nestane, a niko se ne seća ko je Sajmon.

programme.desc: Džeronimo je gospodin miš koji, pored toga što voli svoj posao i svoju porodicu, obožava da skuplja korice starog sira iz osamnaestog veka. programme.desc: Naša nova serija predstavlja tinejdžera Don Dijega, koji se suočava sa najvećim životnim izazovom boreći se za pravdu protiv brojnih bezobzirnih tirana! Tako se rađa najpoznatiji maskirani heroj. Zoro jednostavno ismeva svoje protivnike učeći ih lekciji i potpisuje svoja dela zaštitnim znakom "Z".

programme.title: Otvorena sezona - Zov prirode
programme.desc: Bug i Eliot se zbližavaju sa Dinom i njegovom bandom oposuma, uzbudljivim, ali sumnjivim likovima. Privučeni sjajem televizije, video igara i ukusne nezdrave hrane, ne primećuju šta se zaista dešava.

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Šampolion, papagaj poznatog arheologa ser Artura Bonsa, poziva Klever kada njegovog vlasnikaotme humanoidni robot pošto je pronašao poznato blago templara.

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Snoubol i Čarkoil, Kleverine komšije iz prodavnice kućnih ljubimaca, oteli su tokom noći. Klever dobija tablet koji ih prikazuje kao zarobljenike. Prepoznaje mesto gde su zatočeni: sobu sa blagom templara.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Alvin mora da pohađa kurs o manirima pre nego što ispuni svoj san i upozna prelepu englesku princezu! Jedini problem je što mora da ubedi Britani da je dostojan toga.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Ubeđeni da Sajmon ide u internat, Alvin i Teodor će pokušati sve da spreče njegov odlazak i zadrže ga kod kuće.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Pets Klub mora da nađe angorskog zeca Kukija, krznenu lopticu, veliku mekanu igračku! Lora ga je dobila za svoj rođendan dan ranije, a narednog jutra je nestao, pa ne bi trebalo da bude daleko. Ali teško je istraživati sa dvoje nevaljalaca koji jurcaju okolo, a to su Džeremaja (Lorin mlađi brat) i Agata (Timova mlađa sestra)! Pets klub prati Kukijeve tragove, pronalazi sve što je grickao, i na kraju saznaje da je ljubomorni mlađi brat sakrio zeca.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Zašto bi Perdita, Lorencova voljena i mažena ženka dalmatinca, pobegla? Zahvaljujući Timovoj mlađoj sestri Agati, naši mladi istraživači otkrivaju da su i neke Perditine stvari (loptica i ćebence) takođe nestale i da je jela više nego obično. Shvataju i da je Lorencova mama u devetom mesecu trudnoće. Zahvaljujući Žilu, njihovom drugu veterinaru, oni povezuju sve ove tragove i otkrivaju da je Perdita pobegla zato što i ona očekuje bebe.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad na posao
programme.desc: Uz pomoć svog starijeg brata i partnera, Tima, Mali šef nastavlja da se bori u surovom korporativnom svetu firme Bebeći Odred, dok se svim silama trudi da postigne skoro neverovatnu stvar: balans između poslovnog i privatnog života.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad na posao
programme.desc: Uz pomoć svog starijeg brata i partnera, Tima, Mali šef nastavlja da se bori u surovom korporativnom svetu firme Bebeći Odred, dok se svim silama trudi da postigne skoro neverovatnu stvar: balans između poslovnog i privatnog života.
